context: Yumiko visits Kenji at the office with a small gift.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 健次さん、これ、家族から、お礼。
lines.en: Kenji-san — this is a little thank you from our family.
lines.style: Warm, genuine maternal tone. Slight pause before offering the gift, like she's thought carefully about this moment. Soft, sincere — not flowery, but real. Voice settles into gentleness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: え、わざわざ、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Oh — you didn't have to, but thank you so much.
lines.style: Surprised, then genuinely pleased. Brief hesitation on the opening, caught off-guard in a good way. Warm formality — respectful but not stiff. Gratitude settles into his voice by the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: You've always been so thoughtful with them.
lines.style: Steady, appreciative. No rush. Each phrase lands with quiet weight — she means this deeply. Soft smile underneath the words, visible even in voice alone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Not at all — I'm the one who's grateful.
lines.style: Humble, genuine deflection. Soft start, steady middle. Not false modesty — he actually means this. Composure sits lightly, warmth shows through.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族、皆、感謝、しています。
lines.en: My whole family appreciates everything you do.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on 'whole family' — she's speaking for something larger than herself. Deeper tone, more grounded. Warmth becomes tender, almost protective in its sincerity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Your kind words mean so much to me, truly.
lines.style: Softer now, vulnerability just beneath the surface. Slight breathiness on 'truly' — this matters more than politeness requires. Warmth and genuine feeling intertwined.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 一緒に、これからも、よろしく。
lines.en: I hope we can continue working together like this.
lines.style: Warm closing. Slow, intentional pacing. 'Like this' carries the weight — she's talking about the whole relationship, not just a job. Gentle but sure. A quiet promise in her voice.
